heroBody: Robot vacuums in Singapore have moved well past the early random-bump prototypes. Current models build a persistent map of your home, navigate room-by-room with LiDAR or vision, dock themselves to empty the bin and recharge, and on flagship units mop with electronically controlled water flow. The Singapore market is dominated by Roborock, Dreame, Xiaomi and Ecovacs at the value end, with iRobot Roomba and a handful of European brands at the premium tier. This page pulls live listings from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes so the price on each card is what Singapore retailers are actually charging right now, not a static snapshot from earlier in the year.

highlightSectionTitle: What changed with robot vacuums in 2026

highlights.title: LiDAR navigation is now standard at the mainstream price
highlights.body: Two years ago, persistent LiDAR mapping was a premium feature; in 2026 mainstream models in the mid-three-figure Singapore dollar range ship with LiDAR as standard. The result is faster mapping, more reliable room-to-room navigation and much better recovery when the robot gets manually moved or stuck.

highlights.title: Self-emptying docks are now mainstream
highlights.body: Docks that automatically empty the robot's bin into a sealed bag, and on premium models also wash and dry the mop pads with hot water, are no longer flagship-only features. A mainstream-priced robot with a self-emptying dock is the sweet spot for most Singapore households, especially those with pets.

highlights.title: Mopping has caught up
highlights.body: Early robot mops dragged a wet pad across the floor and left streaks. Current flagship models use electronically controlled water flow, vibrating mop heads and hot-water dock washing. For HDB floors that are predominantly tile, a good vacuum-mop combo removes the need for a separate mop entirely for daily maintenance.

adviceSectionTitle: How to pick a robot vacuum without overspending
advicePoints: Buy the right dock for your household. If you have pets, the self-emptying dock is non-negotiable. If you do not have pets, you can save meaningful money by skipping it and emptying the bin yourself once a week.
Check the climb height. Older HDB thresholds and door bars can stop a low-profile robot. Most current models handle thresholds up to about 2cm; if your home has higher thresholds, measure first.

Pick LiDAR over camera-only navigation for reliability in dim rooms. Singapore HDB living rooms are often shaded in the evening and camera-only robots lose their way in low light. LiDAR works regardless of lighting.

Plan for replacement parts. Side brushes, mop pads and HEPA filters are wear items that need replacing every few months. Buying a model with widely available spare parts in Singapore is worth a small premium over an obscure brand.

Skip the international version if a Singapore-localised model exists. SG-localised robots ship with the right power plug, the right local app store, and the brand's local warranty; the cheaper international version is not worth the hassle.
faqSectionTitle: Robot vacuums in Singapore — common questions

faqs.question: Are robot vacuums worth it for a Singapore HDB?
faqs.answer: Yes for most HDB layouts. A robot vacuum with LiDAR handles the typical 3-4 room HDB floor plan on a single charge, docks itself between runs, and removes the daily chore of sweeping. For larger condos with multiple rooms and thicker rugs, look at the premium tier with a self-emptying dock and a larger battery.

faqs.question: Which robot vacuum brand is most popular in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Roborock, Xiaomi and Dreame dominate the mainstream and premium tiers by unit volume. iRobot Roomba remains the best-known brand globally and is widely available in Singapore at a premium. Ecovacs is strong in the mid-range. Pick on features and price band rather than brand alone.

faqs.question: Do robot vacuums work well on HDB tile floors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tile is one of the easiest surfaces for a robot vacuum to clean. For vacuum-and-mop combos, set the water flow to medium; too much water on tile leaves streaks and makes the floor slippery.

categoryIntro.heading: Why robot vacuum prices in Singapore swing so widely
categoryIntro.body: Three forces drive the spread between the cheapest and most expensive robot vacuum listings on any given day in Singapore. First, the brand tier: Xiaomi and entry Roborock models sit at the value band, mid-range Roborock and Dreame anchor the mainstream, and flagship Roborock, Ecovacs and iRobot sit at the premium. Second, retailer competition: Shopee Mall, LazMall and Amazon.sg run frequent flash sales and voucher stacks, while Harvey Norman and Courts hold price for longer. Third, parallel-imported units are routinely available at a meaningful discount to authorised-reseller prices but ship without the brand's Singapore warranty. The live cards on this page read current listings rather than a stale 'best price' table so you can compare what is actually available right now.
